playground.integrityNote: SHA-256 of the file actually executed in the browser workspace, compared byte for byte with the source you supplied. It catches a script or the engine modifying the source unintentionally. It is not a defence against a script written to defeat it, which runs in the same interpreter as your figure.
playground.integrityUnavailableNote: This browser could not compute the hash, so the comparison never ran — which is why this does not claim the file is unchanged.

playground.uploadNote: For single-file scripts only — nothing that relies on local data, sibling modules or other local resources.

playground.uploadScopeGood: Works: one UTF-8 .py file; NumPy, Matplotlib and the packages pinned in this runtime; data written in the script or generated by code.

canvas.companionsExplain: Companion elements are titles, axis labels and legends you have positioned by hand, plus colorbar axes and twinx twins. They are either pinned to figure coordinates or are sibling axes, so without this they stay behind when the axes move. Turn it off to move only the axes themselves.
